يعتزلون (form VIII)
# يَعْتَزِلُونَ (yaʕtazilūna) /jaʕ.ta.zi.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
# يُعْتَزَلُونَ (yuʕtazalūna) /juʕ.ta.za.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
